entries.en: PhD candidate in the Division of Regenerative Medicine, the Institute of Medical Science, The University of Tokyo. Studies liver and biliary system development using experimental and computational approaches, with a focus on extrahepatic bile duct organogenesis. Has used three-dimensional imaging and comprehensive gene expression analysis to investigate organ formation and identify candidate regulatory factors. Has also derived hypotheses about developmental mechanisms from single-cell transcriptome analysis and explored them through simulation. Presented this work at a doctoral research presentation meeting, receiving the Excellent Research Award, and at the joint meeting of the Japanese Society for the Research of Hepatic Cells and Hepatic Sinusoidal Research Japan, receiving an Excellent Oral Presentation Award.
entries.ja: 東京大学医科学研究所再生医学分野の博士課程学生。wet実験とdry解析を組み合わせ、肝外胆管の器官形成を中心に肝臓・胆道系の発生を研究する。三次元イメージングと網羅的遺伝子発現解析を行い、器官形成のプロセスや制御因子の候補を明らかにした。さらに、シングルセル・トランスクリプトーム解析から発生メカニズムに関する仮説を導出し、シミュレーションを行った。この研究を博士優秀論文発表会（Excellent Research Award受賞）や第33回肝細胞研究会・第40回肝類洞壁細胞研究会学術集会合同大会（一般口演優秀賞受賞）で発表した。

entries.en: Has worked on differentiation of human induced pluripotent stem cells and induction of epithelial structures based on developmental insights. Aims to elucidate the mechanisms of bile duct development and generate human iPSC-derived bile duct organoids as a model for understanding the etiology and pathogenesis of congenital biliary diseases, including biliary atresia.
entries.ja: 発生学的知見に基づき、ヒトiPS細胞からの分化誘導と上皮構造の誘導に取り組んできた。胆管発生の仕組みを明らかにし、ヒトiPS細胞由来胆管オルガノイドを創出することで、胆道閉鎖症を含む先天性胆管疾患の病因・病態の理解につながるヒトモデルの構築を目指す。

entries.en: Has contributed three-dimensional imaging expertise in organoids and mouse liver tissue to collaborative projects on pancreatic cancer organoids, bile duct formation in human iPSC-derived liver organoids, and liver organoid transplantation. At the Science Moves Conference, presented “Fate decision,” explaining the significance, approach, and motivation of the research to a non-specialist audience.
entries.ja: また、オルガノイドやマウス肝臓の三次元イメージング技術を活かし、膵がんオルガノイド、ヒトiPS細胞由来肝臓オルガノイドの胆管形成、肝臓オルガノイド移植に関する複数の共同研究に貢献した。Science Moves Conferenceでは「運命決定」と題し、研究の意義、アプローチ、動機を研究の専門家ではない一般の人々に向けて紹介した。
